title: Step after invoicing lists lines-added services; already-complete excluded
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with View and edit customers, on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. A service is due or overdue on an enrolled asset (e.g. 'PM-A' on unit 'ZZAUTOTEST Truck 12').
custom_steps:
1. Invoice a work order that added the lines of one or more services.
  2. Confirm the step lists each such service, ticked by default, with its reason (e.g. 'Lines added from PM-A').
  3. Untick one and confirm it does not reset and stays due.
  4. Confirm a service already reset by Mark complete is not listed, and a service whose schedule was removed while the work order was open is not listed and does not reset.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The step after invoicing lists every service whose lines were added on this work order, each ticked by default and can be unticked, with its reason (e.g. 'Lines added from PM-A').
  • An unticked service does not reset and stays due.
  • A service already reset by Mark complete is not listed (a service resets once); a service whose schedule was removed while the work order was open is not listed and does not reset.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10574 (S18, Complete a service and reset the cycle); Chunk 2 MR spec (Confluence 897679389), Part 1 / S18; read 2 Oct 2026. Source-verified 2 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S18-R8: “The step after invoicing lists every service whose lines were added on this work order, each ticked by default and can be unticked, with its reason, for example Lines added from PM-A. An unticked service does not reset and stays due. A service already reset by Mark complete is not listed: a service resets once”
  • S18-R18: “A service whose schedule was removed from the asset while its work order was open is not listed in the step after invoicing and does not reset”
